name: Rice (Imperial Harvest Detail)
description: Exquisite 3D showcase of imperial province rice. A pitch-black lacquered ceramic bowl filled with glistening white pearlescent rice grains, resting beside a rustic dark burlap sack tied with vibrant crimson red braided silk cords and golden rice grain stalks. Dramatic studio lighting with vivid crimson backlighting and rim highlights against a pure pitch-black background.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of imperial Japanese rice commodity. A pitch-black lacquered wooden bowl filled with steaming pearlescent white rice grains, next to a coarse dark woven burlap sack tied with rich bright crimson red (#FF2035) silk cords and golden rice grain stalks. Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000), dramatic crimson red studio rim lighting and volumetric dark atmosphere, hyper-detailed textures, 8k render, no text, no watermark.
